_about: Known-harmless kinds: counted, never posted. match is a regular expression on the signature (knownissues.py --list shows them); source limits it to server, client or launcher. Give every entry its reason and who decided.

ignore.match: ^SendToNeighbours - No permission to update actor <id> \(not a hoster\)$
ignore.reason: a movement update from a client that just lost the hoster role to another player; the server drops it, by design

ignore.match: ^SendToNeighbours - No permission to send \w+ with \w+ actor <id>$
ignore.reason: SendToNeighbours permission bursts (OnSpellCast, OnHit) from a client that does not host the actor; refused, by design
handled throws in debugsnap.js and npcground.js for an actor whose base comes from a plugin the espm table does not index; not player-visible (Worker B's triage, 1 Oct 07:55Z)
